verdict.rationale: Runloop's core interface is the `rli` CLI (interactive TUI plus traditional commands) and REST/SDK APIs, not natural-language commands; however an official MCP server is documented (runloop-probe-4), which would let AI agents/assistants operate Runloop resources via natural-language-driven tool calls. There's no direct evidence of a chat-based or NL command interface for the CLI/dashboard itself. Missing for 10: documented NL command syntax or examples of natural-language-driven operation, evidence of the MCP server being exercised via NL prompts, and any first-party chat/assistant UI.
